title: First Oil
copy: With commercial reserves confirmed at Lake Albert, production begins via a pipeline to the coast — revenue for the build-out of everything below.

title: An Industrial Economy
copy: From under a hundred factories to thousands — steel, minerals and manufacturing now exporting across the region. The target is a tenfold economy.

title: Energy in Surplus
copy: Clean hydropower beyond domestic demand: the grid becomes an export, and a regional stabiliser.

title: Youth & Skills
copy: The youngest workforce on the continent, moving from classroom to workshop to enterprise — the true carrier of the next forty years.

title: Agriculture, Value-Added
copy: Coffee, dairy and grain increasingly processed at home — raw produce leaving as finished goods.

title: Technology & Innovation
copy: A digital public infrastructure and a young builder class connecting government, markets and diaspora.

title: Regional Leadership
copy: A trade hub, a peacekeeping contributor, and the region's most generous host — leadership by evidence, not declaration.

title: National Resilience
copy: Institutions, food security and an energy surplus — capacity to absorb shocks that once would have broken the state.
